name: 小帅

character.name: 小帅
character.personality: 真诚、内敛、容易紧张，逐渐愿意自己开口
character.direction_zh: 轻柔清亮的少年男声，略带气息；自然思考停顿，紧张但不持续结巴。与分身保持相近的基础声线。
character.instruct: The speaker is a 16-year-old male high-school student. A light, youthful tenor, with a little breathiness and a slightly reedy, unpolished teenage texture. Modest chest resonance. He is sincere, thoughtful and a little shy. He speaks gently, with small thinking pauses and understated emotion, gradually finding the confidence to finish his thought. Keep a believable adolescent male sound, without a deep adult presenter voice or a squeaky child voice.
character.text: Give me a second. I want to say this myself. I get nervous when everyone is looking at me, but that doesn't mean I have nothing to say. Let's start with one question, and listen to the answer before we move on.

full_instruction: The speaker is a 16-year-old male high-school student. A light, youthful tenor, with a little breathiness and a slightly reedy, unpolished teenage texture. Modest chest resonance. He is sincere, thoughtful and a little shy. He speaks gently, with small thinking pauses and understated emotion, gradually finding the confidence to finish his thought. Keep a believable adolescent male sound, without a deep adult presenter voice or a squeaky child voice. Speak clear, natural conversational American English. Use a comfortable medium pace and natural sentence pauses so a high-school English learner can follow. Keep an everyday human delivery, with no music or sound effects, no announcer performance, and no theatrical exaggeration. Read only the supplied text.
